name: Putorana Plateau
description: The Putorana Plateau is a remote mountain massif in northern Central Siberia, about 100 km north of the Arctic Circle. Within the protected reserve, one isolated range holds taiga, forest tundra, tundra and arctic desert, along with untouched cold-water lakes and rivers. Every year a huge reindeer herd crosses it on one of the world's last great migration routes.
